title: WebStoreNetwork - Data API
description: Represents the relationship between a web store and an experience site. This object is available in API version 49.0 and later.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: Name of the web store network.

NetworkId.description: ID of the experience site associated with the web store. This field is a relationship field.

WebStoreId.description: ID of the web store associated with the experience site. This field is a relationship field.

usage: After you copy web store data between a sandbox and production, or between sandboxes, you can programmatically associate the copy with a different site by updating the corresponding WebStoreNetwork record. You can even change the association while the store is active. The site must use a template that’s compatible with the web store type, and the site can’t be associated with a store. Otherwise, you can change the association only by editing the web store in the UI.
